title: Here and Now
summary: The painting is present only in the one tab holding an exclusive lock; open it twice and the copy is made to wait its turn.
mechanism: Web Locks API exclusive lock (navigator.locks.request) bound to the artwork's visibility, held for the tab's lifetime, with a live navigator.locks.query() queue count; no network or storage.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
